title: 同义替换识别专项
passage: 同义替换识别专项训练：找出与原文意思最接近的改写。

questions.question_text:
原文：The new policy will bring about significant changes in the education system.

哪个选项与原句中 "bring about" 的意思最接近？
questions.analysis: bring about 意为"引起、导致"，与 lead to 同义。take away 是"带走"，put up with 是"忍受"，look forward to 是"期待"。

questions.question_text:
原文：Scientists have found a novel approach to treating the disease.

"novel approach" 最接近哪个表达？
questions.analysis: novel 作形容词意为"新颖的"，approach 意为"方法"，novel approach = new way。

questions.question_text:
原文：The phenomenon is attributed to several interrelated factors.

"is attributed to" 可以替换为：
questions.analysis: be attributed to 意为"归因于"，与 be caused by（由...引起）意思最接近。

questions.question_text:
原文：The company's profits declined substantially last year.

"substantially" 的同义替换是：
questions.analysis: substantially 意为"大幅度地、显著地"，与 significantly 同义。slightly 是"轻微地"，steadily 是"稳定地"，suddenly 是"突然地"。

questions.question_text:
原文：The findings underscore the importance of early intervention.

"underscore" 最接近的意思是：
questions.analysis: underscore 本义是"在下面划线"，引申为"强调"，与 emphasize 同义。undermine 是"削弱"，understand 是"理解"，undertake 是"承担"。
